2610.08413.title: Knowing When Not to Answer: Cross-Domain and Multi-Turn Generalization of Latent Underspecification Signals
2610.08413.paper_summary: Large language models routinely answer questions that cannot be answered from the information given, and in dialogue they answer before enough has been said. Unanswerability is linearly decodable from hidden states, but it is unclear which of its forms share a representation and whether the signal is useful in dialogue. We contribute a turn-labeled multi-turn benchmark (423 conversations, 1,661 labeled turn-states) and an evaluation harness with a simulated user who answers clarifying questions, and use them with six datasets and six open-weight LLMs to test how far probes for unanswerability carry. Probes transfer robustly between datasets that share a ground of unanswerability: missing information in math (AUROC 0.77-0.97) and in a passage (SQuAD 2.0<->MuSiQue, 0.77-0.90). Probes for epistemic "known-unknowns" transfer poorly to math, but this separation weakens under lexical controls and changes with layer and coordinate system, so it remains unresolved. Single-turn probes fail zero-shot to detect when a conversation becomes answerable; in-structure probes recover it, but no better than a bag-of-words classifier. A gate on the calibrated probe, with no model fine-tuning, fires on underspecified turns far more precisely than chance, and its end-task success comes within 0.08 of a gate given the true labels. Yet across four models it does not reliably beat vanilla generation or prompted consolidation. The remaining gap lies mostly in how models use a clarification, not in detection.
2610.08413.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型經常回答無法從所提供的信息中得出的問題，而在對話中，它們在尚未說出足夠內容之前就給出了回答。無法回答性可以從隱藏狀態線性解碼，但尚不清楚其形式中哪些共享表示，以及該信號在對話中是否有用。我們貢獻了一個標註回合的多回合基準（423 次對話，1,661 個標註回合狀態）和一個評估工具，該工具擁有一個模擬用戶，該用戶回答澄清問題，並將其與六個數據集和六個開放權重的 LLM 一起使用，以測試無法回答性的探測器能夠推進多遠。探測器在共享無法回答性基礎的數據集之間穩健轉移：數學中的缺失信息（AUROC 0.77-0.97）和段落中的缺失信息（SQuAD 2.0<->MuSiQue, 0.77-0.90）。對於認識論上的“已知未知”探測器在數學中轉移效果不佳，但這種區分在詞彙控制下會減弱，並隨著層和坐標系的變化而改變，因此仍然未解決。單回合探測器在零樣本情況下無法檢測對話何時變得可回答；結構內的探測器能夠恢復這一點，但效果不比詞袋分類器好。經過校準的探測器上的閘門，在沒有模型微調的情況下，對於不明確的回合的反應遠比隨機更精確，其最終任務成功率與給定真實標籤的閘門相差僅 0.08。然而，在四個模型中，它並不可靠地超越普通生成或提示整合。剩餘的差距主要在於模型如何使用澄清，而不是在於檢測。
